messages.content: Find a pet-friendly train station in Miami

function.name: find_hotel
function.description: Search for hotels based on specific criteria like price range and pet policy. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city where you want to book the hotel.

max_price_per_night.description: The maximum amount you are willing to pay per night. This is a float type value.

pet_friendly.description: Whether the hotel should allow pets. Defaults to false.

**Pet‑Friendly Train Station in Miami** | Feature | Details | |---------|---------| | **Station Name** | Amtrak – Miami Intermodal Center (MIA) | | **Address** | 1 SE 1st Ave, Miami, FL 33131 | | **Phone** | 305‑284‑4000 (Amtrak Customer Service) | | **Website** | https://www.amtrak.com/stations/mia | | **Pet Policy** | • Small pets (≤ 20 lb) are allowed in carriers on Amtrak’s Silver Service trains (Florida & Georgia).
• Pets must be leashed or in a carrier while on the platform and in the train car.
• A pet relief area is located near the main entrance of the station for quick access.
• No pets are allowed on the platform during boarding unless accompanied by a staff member. | | **Accessibility** | The station is fully ADA‑accessible and has designated pet relief areas for convenience. | **Key Points** - The Miami Intermodal Center serves as the primary Amtrak hub in the city, connecting to local transit (Metrorail, Metrobus, and the new MIA Mover). - While the station itself does not have a “pet‑friendly” label, Amtrak’s pet policy applies to all trains departing from this location. - For the most up‑to‑date information on pet restrictions, fees, and carrier requirements, call Amtrak’s customer service line at **1‑800‑USA‑RAIL (1‑800‑872‑7245)** or visit the station’s page on Amtrak’s website. **Quick Contact** - **Amtrak Customer Service:** 1‑800‑USA‑RAIL (1‑800‑872‑7245) - **Miami Intermodal Center (MIA) Phone:** 305‑284‑4000 - **Website:** https://www.amtrak.com/stations/mia Feel free to call ahead to confirm pet‑related details before your trip!
